data: 320 original-color PlantVillage tomato images; 40 per category across 8 categories
evaluation: 80 held-out images, 10 per category; 240 training images, 30 per category; disjoint leaf groups
model: StandardScaler + logistic regression (C=1.0, max_iter=1000) on 48 RGB histogram features
limitation: Only 80 held-out PlantVillage images (10 per category) across eight categories; Target Spot and mosaic virus are excluded because leaf mappings are unavailable. Controlled leaf photographs do not establish performance on grower phone photos, unknown conditions, or real-world disease prevalence. Color features may learn background or lighting differences instead of disease symptoms.
